action.objective: Verify h7g7: win the g7 pawn, keep the queen near Black's king, and confirm king safety against Qxe4/Qxc1+ resources.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search (cutoff at depth 2) gave h7g7 the top exact score 561, above c2b3 559 (upper bound) and other upper-bound rows. Exact score at depth 2 is not a safety proof, so I verify the reserved suggestion h7g7 with its full 2000-node allowance at max depth. Key concerns: Black's h1 queen can take e4/c1 or harass c2, and the f7 bishop must stay protected; I need to confirm no tactical refutation or forced mate against White's king on c2.
